description: This file contains unit tests for the AppGateway component, using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks. It tests functionalities such as ping response, getInfo, setConfig, and reinitialization of the AppGateway plugin.

classes.name: AppGatewayTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing AppGateway functionalities, setting up mock services and handling test lifecycle.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, unregisters the plugin, and deinitializes it.
